cards.ex: The insurance company classified the earthquake as an 'Act of God,' so they wouldn't cover the damages.
cards.exUz: Sug'urta kompaniyasi zilzilani 'Tabiiy ofat' deb tasnifladi, shuning uchun ular zararni qoplamaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Inson aralashuvisiz yuzaga keladigan, oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan tabiiy hodisa.

cards.ex: Coastal communities were hit hard by the hurricane.
cards.exUz: Sohil bo'yi jamiyatlariga to'fon qattiq ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir juda qattiq ta'sir qilib, ko'p zarar yetkazmoq.

cards.ex: The oil spill had a devastating impact on the marine ecosystem.
cards.exUz: Neft to'kilishi dengiz ekotizimiga halokatli ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta zarar keltiradigan ta'sir, vayron qiluvchi natija.

cards.ex: The small island nation managed to weather the storm thanks to international aid.
cards.exUz: Kichik orol davlati xalqaro yordam tufayli bo'ronni o'tkaza oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatdan omon qolmoq, muvaffaqiyatli chiqmoq.

cards.ex: Several hikers were stranded in the mountains due to the sudden blizzard.
cards.exUz: Bir nechta sayyohlar tog'larda to'satdan bo'ron tufayli qolib ketishdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyda, odatda xavfli vaziyatda, qolib ketmoq.

cards.ex: In the face of the impending tornado, they evacuated the town.
cards.exUz: Bo'lajak tornado oldida ular shaharni evakuatsiya qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirlar bo'lishiga qaramay, biror narsa qilish.

cards.ex: The government needed to ramp up its disaster relief efforts.
cards.exUz: Hukumat falokatdan keyingi yordam ko'rsatish harakatlarini kuchaytirishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tezroq ko'paytirmoq yoki tezlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: The economy of the region has been on shaky ground since the floods.
cards.exUz: Mintaqa iqtisodiyoti suv toshqinlaridan beri noto'g'ri poydevorda edi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchsiz, noaniq yoki xavfli vaziyatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The climbers were exposed to the elements for days before being rescued.
cards.exUz: Tog'ga chiquvchilar qutqarilishdan oldin bir necha kun davomida tabiat hodisalariga duch kelishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havoning keskin, ko'pincha xavfli sharoitlari.

cards.ex: I completely zoned out during the geography lecture.
cards.exUz: Men geografiya ma'ruzasida butunlay e'tibordan chetda qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni yo'qotmoq, atrofdagilarga e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: Coastal erosion is a major problem in low-lying island nations.
cards.exUz: Sohil yemirilishi pasttekislikdagi orol davlatlarida asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Sohil chizig'ining asta-sekin dengiz to'lqinlari ta'sirida yemirilishi.

cards.ex: The dam's collapse was a catastrophic failure of engineering.
cards.exUz: To'g'onning qulashi muhandislikning halokatli xatosi edi.
cards.uzDef: Katta zarar yoki vayronagarchilikka olib keladigan muvaffaqiyatsizlik.

cards.ex: The village was completely cut off after the bridge collapsed.
cards.exUz: Ko'prik qulaganidan keyin qishloq butunlay aloqadan uzilib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Aloqadan uzilib qolmoq, yordam ololmaslik.

cards.ex: The hurricane was a force of nature that no one could control.
cards.exUz: To'fon - hech kim nazorat qila olmaydigan tabiat kuchi edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kuchli va to'xtatib bo'lmaydigan narsa.

cards.ex: After the earthquake, the community started to pick up the pieces and rebuild.
cards.exUz: Zilziladan keyin jamiyat parvozni tiklashni va qayta qurishni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilikdan so'ng hayotni qayta tiklash.

cards.ex: Climate change is turning more arable land into marginal land.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi ko'proq haydaladigan yerlarni yaroqsiz yerga aylantirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qishloq xo'jaligi uchun unumsiz yoki yaroqsiz bo'lgan yer.

cards.ex: Switzerland is a landlocked country in the heart of Europe.
cards.exUz: Shveytsariya - Yevropaning markazida joylashgan dengizga chiqish yo'li bo'lmagan davlat.
cards.uzDef: Dengizga chiqish yo'li bo'lmagan davlat.

cards.ex: Japan is located within the Ring of Fire, making it prone to earthquakes.
cards.exUz: Yaponiya Olov halqasida joylashganligi sababli, zilzilalarga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Tinch okeanida joylashgan vulqon va zilzilalar faol hududi.

cards.ex: The Missouri River is a major tributary of the Mississippi River.
cards.exUz: Missuri daryosi - Missisipi daryosining asosiy irmoq daryosi.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy daryoga suv quyadigan kichikroq daryo.

cards.ex: The Continental Divide runs along the crest of the Rocky Mountains.
cards.exUz: Kontinental suvayirg'ich Qoyali tog'lar tepasida joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Qit'ada daryolar oqimini ajratib turadigan suvayirg'ich.

cards.ex: The increase in seismic activity worried the scientists.
cards.exUz: Seysmik faollikning ortishi olimlarni tashvishga soldi.
cards.uzDef: Yer qobig'idagi zilzilalar bilan bog'liq faoliyat.

cards.ex: The sailors were at the mercy of the storm.
cards.exUz: Dengizchilar bo'ronning rahmiga tushishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning ta'siriga to'liq bog'liq bo'lmoq, himoyasiz qolmoq.

cards.ex: The elderly are particularly vulnerable to heat waves.
cards.exUz: Keksa odamlar issiqlik to'lqinlariga ayniqsa zaif.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyatda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: After the fire, they had to rebuild their lives from scratch.
cards.exUz: Yong'indan keyin ular hayotlarini noldan qayta qurishga majbur bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay vayron bo'lganidan keyin yangidan qurmoq.

cards.ex: I needed a change of scenery, so I went hiking in the mountains.
cards.exUz: Mengamanzara o'zgarishi kerak edi, shuning uchun men tog'larga sayr qilishga bordim.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va farqli muhit, joy.

cards.ex: Farmers are struggling due to the erratic weather patterns this year.
cards.exUz: Fermerlar bu yil notog'ri ob-havo sharoitlari tufayli qiynalishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan, o'zgaruvchan ob-havo sharoitlari.

cards.ex: The coastal areas will bear the brunt of the hurricane.
cards.exUz: Sohil hududlari to'fonning eng yomon ta'sirini boshdan kechiradi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yomon ta'sirni boshdan kechirmoq, asosiy zararni olmoq.

cards.ex: The storm surge pushed inland, flooding towns miles from the coast.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron to'lqini ichkariga surilib, sohil bo'yidan bir necha mil uzoqlikdagi shaharlarni suv bosdi.
cards.uzDef: Qirg'oqdan uzoqlashmoq, ichki hududga kirmoq.

cards.ex: Homes were swept away by the floodwaters.
cards.exUz: Uylar toshqin suvlari tomonidan oqizib ketildi.
cards.uzDef: Suv yoki boshqa kuchli oqim tomonidan olib ketilmoq.

cards.ex: They had a narrow escape when the volcano erupted.
cards.exUz: Ular vulqon otilganda qutulib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatdan qutulish, falokatdan sal qolishi.
